verdict.rationale: Archived token-scoping docs describe service tokens that limit an agent to listing and calling tools on connections in a namespace matching metadata, which is server- or connection-level scoping. No per-tool allowlist was ever documented. Smithery's own shutdown notice says the API, Connect, accounts and API keys stopped working on 2026-10-31, and it now remains only as a public, non-proxied registry, so no gateway access control is currently delivered.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict which servers and individual tools an agent may call through allowlists or per-tool access control
